name: flee_grace
description: Post-flee encounter grace (~2s): hero spawns adjacent to the chasing kobold at (4,9)/(4,10) and flees the instant battle. Stepping into the kobold during grace only bumps (no fight); SELECT then opens the SAVE screen in the overworld but would execute an attack inside a battle; B backs out of either. End state proves it: still OVERWORLD with the kobold untouched at 15 HP. Without the grace the first step would start battle 2, SELECT would hit for 1+, and the game would still be in battle.
